lines: In the sixty-sixth year, ninth of the dark fortnight —
in Mārgaśīrṣa, by me, Abhinavagupta, was Śiva praised.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭṣaṣṭinām eke varṣe navamyām asite | mayā 'bhinavaguptena mārgaśīrṣe stutaḥ śivaḥ
